orchestration.progression_model: Each GET on /api/jobs/:jobId advances at most one stage for non-terminal jobs.
orchestration.discover: Fetch the submitted URL, parse same-origin anchor links, and fetch a small fixed number of same-origin pages.
orchestration.failure_model: Fail the active stage and persist stage.error plus job.failureMessage when discovery or later stages throw.

jobContract.note: Live jobs no longer depend on fixtureKey-derived completion.

resultContract.policy: One main DESIGN.md plus a partition appendix remains mandatory.

confidenceRules.high: 3 same-origin pages and no fetch failures
confidenceRules.medium: 2 usable pages or minor fetch gaps
confidenceRules.low: Only root page or sparse evidence; generation still continues with risk labels

verification.note: Run build and typecheck sequentially because both write .next.

nextBatchRecommended: Deepen the crawler and evidence model beyond shallow same-origin HTML fetch.
Improve non-DESIGN.md export fidelity and move export generation into dedicated helpers if needed.
Add retry/resume semantics for failed or partial jobs without changing the route contract.
Only consider JS-rendered crawling after the shallow-fetch seam is exhausted.
